name: chubb-man
description: 炫彩票務小幫手 (CHubb-Man) — Discord 管理、票務客服與網頁儀表板一體化方案

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n bot,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start --workspace bot" "npm run start --workspace api" "npm run start --workspace web"
